decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - Full details, with samples, of the new signage, the lettering to the canopy, new fascias to shopfronts, the canopy and brise-soleil, timber decking, French doors and the timber boarding shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on site is commenced.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise in accordance with the details thus approved.

Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE

With respect to the signage included within this application, it may be required to apply for express consent under The Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations 1992.
description: Refurbishment of offices at 2nd floor & ground floor reception & entrance area, incorporating alterations to existing front elevation and construction of timber decking to first floor offices.
